description: jasima SimCore is the core engine of the Java Simulator for Manufacturing and Logistics. Its maintainers publish tools for discrete-event models and computer experiments, with documentation for event-oriented and process-oriented simulation, job shops and an M/M/1 queue. Users provide Java model logic, input distributions and experiment settings; outputs are simulation observations and analysis results. The engine is independent of a particular factory, geographic region or observation period, and temporal detail follows the events defined by the modeller. Source and the Maven Central package are public and free under Apache-2.0. Java 8 or newer is required, and a Maven wrapper is supplied for building from source. This is a developer library, so the example queues do not establish a calibrated production line or predictive accuracy for an actual facility. It supports capacity, bottleneck and logistics experiments. Its discrete-event purpose is comparable to the catalogue's healthcare DES model (model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des), although they use different languages and application structures. This review checked the documentation and licence without running the examples.
